title: Inspect a feature branch against main with local git tools
narrative: Fangore hands guided coding a workspace that already has a feature branch ahead of main. He wants the local agent to inspect status, commit history, and the diff against main using the machine's git, then leave a short inspect note on disk. Complements `fangore_guided_coding_recipe` and `fangore_coding_git_open_pr`.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` with `environment.local_work: project_coding`. Story harness seeds a feature-branch git repo and binds `RecordingPullRequestCodingGit` wrapping `LocalProcessCodingGit` (`environment.coding_git: local_mock_pr`) so status/log/diff use real local `git` while forge calls stay mockable. Tools `git_status` / `git_log` / `git_diff` come from `build_coding_tool_registry(..., coding_git=…)`. Hosts override via `ProjectCodingConfig.get_coding_git()`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `inspect.yaml` in suite `fangore_guided_coding`. Static mode uses `coding_tool_script: git_inspect` (scripted tool calls against local git). Live mode uses a real Completer with the same `local_mock_pr` binding. Unit tests `tests/test_project_coding.py` cover injectable `CodingGit` fakes and local process git.
